description: This file contains a class 'FastMathCalc' that provides methods for extended precision mathematical computations, such as calculating sine, cosine, logarithm, exponential, and their tables, using techniques like double splitting, Taylor series expansion, and extended precision arithmetic.

classes.name: FastMathCalc
classes.description: Contains static methods and constants for high-precision math computations, including trigonometric, exponential, logarithmic functions, and related helper functions.

methods.name: slowCos
methods.description: Computes cosine of x (0 <= x <= pi/4) using Taylor series with extended precision.

methods.name: slowSin
methods.description: Computes sine of x (0 <= x <= pi/4) using Taylor series with extended precision.

methods.name: slowLog
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of xi via a Remez approximation method, handling input values with high precision.

methods.name: slowexp
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of x using extended precision, suitable for input ranges where standard double precision may be insufficient.

methods.name: expint
methods.description: Computes exp(p) for integer p using binary exponentiation and extended precision arithmetic.
